anicraft.description:
2D vector animation studio; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Animate, rebuilt in pure Rust.

A native 2D vector animation editor with timeline, layers, keyframes, classic and shape tweens, onion skinning, and an egui stage. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly. Built by the ArtCraft team.
